coverage.boundedSampleReason: Each table is compiled for the most recent year its own header publishes (CAINC1 2024; SARPP 2024; MARPP 2024). The tables carry annual series back to 1969 and 2008 respectively, and every year of them is present in the committed artifacts; compiling all of them would produce hundreds of thousands of separately evidenced observations for a substrate that has no consumer for the series yet. Widening the bound is a recompile, not another retrieval.
coverage.universeDescription: Bureau of Economic Analysis regional estimates for every area published in three tables: CAINC1 county and state personal income, SARPP state regional price parities, and MARPP metropolitan regional price parities. Every area each table publishes is present; the bound is temporal, not geographic.
